name: devwork-triage-loop
description: Portable maintainer-review loop for inspecting issues, drafting follow-up comments, and deciding whether to resolve, revise, or hand off.

phases.objective: Inspect the issue thread, current repository state, and maintainer context to decide whether there is enough evidence to draft a follow-up or whether the work should hand off.

outcomes.description: The issue has enough context to prepare a maintainer-facing follow-up comment.
The issue should hand off because the current maintainer does not have enough authority, context, or repository access to proceed.

phases.objective: Draft the next maintainer comment, summarize the current issue position, and capture any follow-up notes that should survive this review pass.

outcomes.description: The draft is ready for a final resolve-or-handoff decision.
The draft exposed a missing detail and the issue should return to inspection before a maintainer response is finalized.

phases.objective: Decide whether to resolve the current review pass, revise the drafted comment, or hand the work off to another maintainer.

outcomes.description: The issue review pass is complete and the current maintainer decision can close the loop.
The current comment needs another drafting pass before the maintainer decision is settled.
The issue should hand off because the next step belongs to another maintainer or queue owner.
